name: Pajares de Adaja (Spain)
description: White field with a blue wavy diagonal stripe from the upper hoist to the lower fly, a red thatched barn in the fly triangle and three green ears of wheat in the hoist triangle.
history: The arms and the flag were approved on 22 May 2004 (Boletín Oficial de Castilla y León no. 134 of 14 July 2004); the flag is rectangular of 2:3, white, with a blue wavy stripe one sixth of the width from the upper hoist to the lower fly, the fly triangle charged with a red barn and the hoist triangle with three green ears of wheat.

features.role: wavy diagonal stripe from the upper hoist to the lower fly
